title: First Normal Form (1NF) Fundamentals
realWorldScenario: A legacy customer table stores phone numbers as a comma-separated string: "555-1234, 555-5678".
questionStatement: What rule does this design violate in relational database normalization? Explain First Normal Form (1NF) and how to refactor this design.
expectedConcepts: No repeating groups or comma-separated lists
hints: Think about how hard it is to search for a specific phone number in a comma-separated string.
How would you enforce phone number formatting or indexing?
